T: › [ T ] informal to get rid of or kill something or someone, especially intentionally

I or T, usually + adv/prep: › [ I or T,  usually + adv/prep ] UK informal to go somewhere or do something quickly

I usually + adv/prep: › [ I usually + adv/prep ] informal to use an electronic device to change television channels quickly, sometimes to avoid watching advertisements
快速變換頻道（以跳過電視廣告）

T: › [ T ] informal to cook something in a microwave

NONE: › an electric shock or something similar
電擊，電流；類似電擊（或電流）的

example: They have the kind of weapons that can zap the enemy from thousands of miles away.
他們擁有那種可以將敵人消滅在千里之外的武器。
figurative We're really going to zap the competition with this new product!
我們這種新產品的確無人能及！
Have I got time to zap into town and do some shopping?
我有時間趕到市區去買些東西嗎？
George zapped through his homework and rushed out to play basketball.
喬治匆匆做完作業，然後衝出去踢足球了。
There are now over a million American fax machines zapping (= sending quickly) messages from coast to coast.
現在有100多萬台美國傳真機在東西海岸之間迅速傳遞訊息。
Don't bake potatoes in the oven, zap them in the microwave - dinner in 10 minutes!
別用烤箱烤馬鈴薯，用微波爐吧——晚餐十分鐘就好。
The device gives cold batteries a zap of energy to bring them back to life.
這種設備給低溫下的電池注入電流，使其恢復功用。
The zap is as strong as an electric eel's.
這種電流跟電鰻釋放的強度類似。

NONE: › a device for controlling a machine from a distance
› a device that kills or gets rid of something, especially by using electricity

example: Use the zapper to turn off the TV.
用遙控器關掉電視。
a fly zapper
